claims.claim: The DOM represents a document's structure in memory and connects web pages to scripts or programming languages.
Document.querySelector() returns the first element matching a CSS selector and returns null if none matches.
Node.textContent represents the text content of a node and its descendants.
Document.createElement() creates an HTMLElement with the specified local name.
DOM work can distinguish selection, a null check, and a targeted text update.
